scenarios.name: a connection promoted to webrtc carries input and the source gets it in order
the viewer leaving while the channel holds a button releases it through the source
a close of viewer-left names the connection or does nothing
a resize request reaches the source; a failure is reported
geometry changes go to every viewer of the source; no geometry ends them
the viewer leaves: stopped, closed, its connection ended
a sender that is gone fails every live connection
a failed capture fails the connections of that source only
the sender reports a failure of a connection
the signals a phone signal causes are sent before it settles
a signal that could not be sent is reported and does not fail the call
a phone close that demotes sends the demote before the call settles
the negotiation timeout fails the connection back to JPEG
the source stops when its last connection closes, not before
pictures: one in flight per source, the newest supersedes the waiting one
a static page: the newest delivered picture goes again to a connection that comes up
a static page: a second viewer connecting gets the newest picture too
a picture that arrives while one is waiting is the one sent after the connection comes up
a picture of an earlier document does not count as a current one (media-ready waits)
channel pushes go to each viewer of the source whose channel is up
dispose stops every viewer
a second ready supersedes the connection and a new one opens after the hand-back
a phone receiver report is measured, not forwarded
